text: E1a opened: the audit's scripts (stage E1, step a; the PI's message of 16:56 UTC on J's word, 27 Oct 17:56 Berlin). Oriented: AGENT.md, head (written at D6a-18), STAGE-E1-formalizing-audit.md, the last five diary lines, validate.py --open E1 (2 errors: fork_comparison-C2.json and fork_comparison-D.json absent; the stage file says they arrive only where the run was forked); no .pause. Carried for this leg: prior.md section 3's element-reach half moves to E1 (computed here or in an audit section, said where); defects 100 and 101 reported open, not rewritten; PR-D6-10 stays unvalidated and the audit checks it against the D3a-55 ruling; D6a-09 to D6a-18 are part of the run audited; at the close I say how many audit sections (E1b-NN) I plan and what each covers. Every script goes in out/audit-E1/ with its output beside it; no earlier file changes (rule 18).

E1a script 1, quotes_resolve.py (out/audit-E1/, output quotes_resolve.json; the rule is in its docstring, declared before the run): 5,953 analyst files scanned, 5,166 with quotes. Cited concept quotes 3,230: 3,218 resolve to the concept they cite; 12 do not (2 to nothing: account-p1.md suomi/c0098, serial-C5/finding-2-reason-test.md polyamory/c0002; 2 to another concept: forms/F16-account.md pcmasterrace/c0596, serial-C5/finding-1-unit.md lakers/c0155; 1 to a label: notes-A1.md predators/c0047; 7 are return lines or model text quoted beside an evidence citation). Uncited spans of five words or more that resolve to nothing in the store, the case accounts, the instrument's texts or the instructions: 2,042, listed for reading in the audit section. The five spot-check quotes are drawn by seed (out/seed.txt) in the output. Two earlier runs are kept as quotes_resolve.superseded-1.json and -2.json: the first paired quotes wrongly where a short quote was skipped, the second took a citation that belonged to the next quote; both fixed before this run.

E1a scripts 2 and 3. links_check.py (output links_check.txt): links.py and validate.py --links both exit 0, 'links: 3 files checked, all ids resolve'. quote_check_raw.py (output quote_check_raw.json) over the handler's quote-check-E1.json (seed 13, 80 rooms): code_quote_found_share 1.0 (14,587 coder quotes: 13,374 exact, 1,213 inside the item, 0 absent); case_quote_found_share 0.6573 (1,051 of 1,599 case-account strings found). The file lists 389 missing strings in 69 rooms, against 548 by its own count (to be explained in the audit section). First sorting by script: 227 of the 389 are in the room's coded passages once case and end punctuation are set aside (a punctuation-inside-quotes artefact of the check, to be confirmed by reading); 1 only in another room's concepts; 19 near quotes (difflib 0.85 or more); 142 none of these, to be read by hand.

(3) Held: the D1 seal (15 Oct 19:44:16) precedes the first snap listing adaptations.jsonl (D2 adaptations-in, 16 Oct 10:17:19). (4) The model at C5's close is e15f9647…; at D3 and D6, and now, 46384686…: it moved after C5 by the return's rulings, as declared. (5) The branch cuts (moves 200 to 237) were all snapped before the projection first appears (D4a-03's interview cut, 25 Oct 19:16:07). 82 D4 snaps list projections-D4.jsonl and chunk-share-D4: the D4a-03 interview cut, the closes of D4a-04 to D4a-08, and the 76 move snaps 238 to 313 (the room forms J asked for at D4a-05 to D4a-08, after the projection). branches.jsonl equals its last D4 snap. (6) The 11 D6 proposals are all 'unvalidated', on base model 46384686…, which is the D3 freeze; amendments-D6.jsonl holds 0 lines. A read-only run of validate.py E1 now gives 247 errors: notes-E1.md not yet written, and 246 lines (82 snaps by 3 files) of the shape 'lists projections-D4.jsonl'. The check counts these as errors, rule 18 bars changing the snaps, and they are the harness's, so the stage cannot close clean; I ask J.

asked QE1-001: Stage E1's close-check (checks/stage_E1.py, check_orderings) counts as an error every D4 move or cut snap that lists projections-D4.jsonl or chunk-share-D4. 82 such snaps exist, so 246 error lines: the D4a-03 interview cut, the closes of D4a-04 to D4a-08, and the 76 move snaps 238 to 313, which are the room forms you asked for at D4a-05 to D4a-08 after the projection was run. The branch cuts (moves 200 to 237) were all snapped before the projection, and branches.jsonl equals its last D4 snap. Rule 18 bars changing the snaps, and they are the harness's, so every E1 leg will fail its close-check on these lines whatever the audit writes. The audit reports them as the check asks: the room forms were made with the projection in the folder, by your ruling, and are not a recut of the branches. May the handler make the check print these 82 snaps as the audit's finding for the snaps after the last branch cut (move 237), and keep the error for any branch cut snapped after the projection? Or should E1 legs close with the check failing on them? | meanwhile: The check is amended so that the D4 snaps after the last branch cut (move 237) are printed as a finding, not an error; until then I close each E1 leg with done.sh, report these 246 lines as the only failing shape besides any of my own, and change no snap or earlier file.
